status: candidate frozen references; derived and cross-checked by the author TASK, not yet independently refuted
theory: small-displacement linear-elastic cantilever; Euler-Bernoulli flexure, plus the Timoshenko shear deflection q L^2 / (2 G A_s) with A_s = kappa_E A_n on the nominal annulus where selected; rotations are section rotations

conventions.support_reaction: global action of the support on the structure at its node (moments about that node)
conventions.section_action: element-local action on the +x face of the i-side portion at station s/L (local x from i to j); a node-on-element end action is -section(0) at end_i and +section(1) at end_j
conventions.section_stress: bending normal stress M / Z of the station's section action on the named basis, Z = I / R with I on that basis's wall; it follows the section action at every station, end_i included (no end-action sign)
conventions.local_axes: x along global X from A to B; y = global Y (y_reference); z = global Z

criterion: |observed - expected| <= 1e-9 * |expected|; an exactly zero expectation uses 1e-9 * zero_scale of its family (largest nonzero magnitude of that family in the case)

crosscheck.check: mass difference: closed form equals mu_EX - mu_PF
kappa_E: cancellation-free form equals the contract form
reduced wall: t_r = (t - c_m) - c_a is the pressure bore's wall
